# UI tools

Build, style, inspect and drive user interfaces.

4 tools in the `ui` category. Badges: **read-only** tools never change the project; **mutating** tools are undoable and attributed; **open-world** tools reach outside the engine and MCP clients ask before running them.

| Tool | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`ui_create`](#ui_create) | Build a whole user interface (HUD, menu, dialog, inventory, document) from one declarative JSON tree in a single undoable step. |
| [`ui_style`](#ui_style) | Restyle a UI. |
| [`ui_inspect`](#ui_inspect) | Read the computed UI layout: every element's rect [x, y, w, h] in pixels for a viewport (default: the canvas's reference resolution), visibility, text, values and style classes, as a tree. |
| [`ui_interact`](#ui_interact) | Use a widget the way a player would: click a button (sends Wander `on ui "&lt;name&gt;"` and `on click` on the next tick while playing), toggle, set a slider/progress value, type into an input, scroll a scroll view, or click at a pixel (hit-tested like a mouse). |

### `ui_create` { #ui_create }

**Build UI** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--mut" title="Changes the project; undoable and attributed">mutating</span>

Build a whole user interface (HUD, menu, dialog, inventory, document) from one declarative JSON tree in a single undoable step. Each node: {type: panel|image|text|button|toggle|slider|progress|scroll|input|spacer, name, text, image, style (classes, e.g. "primary large"), css (inline style), anchor (top_left, top, top_right, left, center, right, bottom_left, bottom, bottom_right, fill, top_stretch, bottom_stretch, left_stretch, right_stretch...), position [x,y] (offset, y down), size [w,h], margin, layout (row|column|grid), gap, padding (CSS order), align (start|center|end|stretch), justify (start|center|end|space_between), columns, fit (none|width|height|both), flex, value, event, children: [...]}. Text nodes size to their content by default; button names default to their text, so `on ui "Play"` works. Without `parent` a new screen canvas is made (configure it with `canvas`). Templates: main_menu, hud, pause_menu, settings, inventory, document, dialogue (the dialogue box the dialogue system uses). Returns created ids and the computed layout (rects in pixels at the canvas's reference resolution). Example: {"root": {"type": "panel", "anchor": "center", "layout": "column", "gap": 12, "style": "card", "children": [{"type": "text", "text": "Paused", "style": "heading"}, {"type": "button", "text": "Resume", "style": "primary"}]}}

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `root` | object |  | One UI tree (node with children) |  |
| `elements` | object[] |  | Several sibling trees |  |
| `template` | string |  | Start from a prebuilt tree (added after root/elements) | `main_menu` `hud` `pause_menu` `settings` `inventory` `document` `dialogue` |
| `parent` | integer \| string |  | Canvas or UI element to add under (default: a new canvas) |  |
| `canvas` | object |  | New canvas: {name, mode: screen\|world, theme: dark\|light\|parchment\|glass\|pixel, referenceResolution, styleSheet, sortOrder, worldScale} |  |
| `width` | integer |  | Viewport width for the returned layout (default: reference resolution) |  |
| `height` | integer |  | Viewport height for the returned layout |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    ui_create {"root": {"type": "panel", "anchor": "center", "layout": "column", "gap": 12, "style": "card", "children": [{"type": "text", "text": "Paused", "style": "heading"}, {"type": "button", "text": "Resume", "style": "primary"}]}}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call ui_create '{"root": {"type": "panel", "anchor": "center", "layout": "column", "gap": 12, "style": "card", "children": [{"type": "text", "text": "Paused", "style": "heading"}, {"type": "button", "text": "Resume", "style": "primary"}]}}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "ui_create",
        "arguments": {
          "root": {
            "type": "panel",
            "anchor": "center",
            "layout": "column",
            "gap": 12,
            "style": "card",
            "children": [
              {
                "type": "text",
                "text": "Paused",
                "style": "heading"
              },
              {
                "type": "button",
                "text": "Resume",
                "style": "primary"
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    }
    ```

### `ui_style` { #ui_style }

**Style UI** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--mut" title="Changes the project; undoable and attributed">mutating</span>

Restyle a UI. Switch a canvas's built-in theme (dark, light, parchment, glass, pixel), write style rules to a style sheet (*.uistyle.json) the canvas uses — rules map selectors (widget kind "button", class ".primary", entity "#Title", "canvas" for text defaults) to properties, with hover/pressed/focus/checked/disabled blocks and $vars — or set one element's classes / inline css. Properties: background, background2 (gradient), backgroundImage, slice (9-slice), radius, borderWidth, borderColor, shadowColor, shadowOffset, shadowBlur, opacity, padding, font, fontSize, color, textAlign, verticalAlign, bold, italic, lineSpacing, letterSpacing, textTransform, textOutline, textOutlineColor, textShadowColor, textShadowOffset, accent, track, knob, trackHeight, knobSize, placeholderColor, imageFit, imageTint, transition. Example: {"canvas": "HUD", "path": "ui/game.uistyle.json", "vars": {"accent": "#e8a33d"}, "rules": {"button": {"radius": 4, "hover": {"background": "$accent"}}}}

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `canvas` | integer \| string |  | Canvas to restyle |  |
| `theme` | string |  | Built-in theme for the canvas | `dark` `light` `parchment` `glass` `pixel` |
| `path` | string |  | Style sheet file to write/merge (project-relative, *.uistyle.json) |  |
| `rules` | object |  | selector -&gt; properties |  |
| `vars` | object |  | variables referenced as $name |  |
| `element` | integer \| string |  | Element to restyle |  |
| `style` | string |  | Element classes (replaces), e.g. "primary large" |  |
| `css` | object |  | Element inline style (merged; null deletes a key) |  |
| `list` | boolean |  | Only list themes, properties and the canvas's selectors |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    ui_style {"canvas": "HUD", "path": "ui/game.uistyle.json", "vars": {"accent": "#e8a33d"}, "rules": {"button": {"radius": 4, "hover": {"background": "$accent"}}}}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call ui_style '{"canvas": "HUD", "path": "ui/game.uistyle.json", "vars": {"accent": "#e8a33d"}, "rules": {"button": {"radius": 4, "hover": {"background": "$accent"}}}}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "ui_style",
        "arguments": {
          "canvas": "HUD",
          "path": "ui/game.uistyle.json",
          "vars": {
            "accent": "#e8a33d"
          },
          "rules": {
            "button": {
              "radius": 4,
              "hover": {
                "background": "$accent"
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    ```

### `ui_inspect` { #ui_inspect }

**Inspect UI** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--ro" title="Never changes the scene">read-only</span>

Read the computed UI layout: every element's rect [x, y, w, h] in pixels for a viewport (default: the canvas's reference resolution), visibility, text, values and style classes, as a tree. Use it to verify a layout without a screenshot, find what to click, or debug overlap. With `element`, also returns its resolved style.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `canvas` | integer \| string |  | Only this canvas |  |
| `element` | integer \| string |  | Only this element (and its children); includes its resolved style |  |
| `width` | integer |  | Viewport width (default: reference resolution) |  |
| `height` | integer |  | Viewport height |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    ui_inspect {"width": 1280, "height": 720}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call ui_inspect '{"width": 1280, "height": 720}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "ui_inspect",
        "arguments": {
          "width": 1280,
          "height": 720
        }
      }
    }
    ```

### `ui_interact` { #ui_interact }

**Use UI** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--mut" title="Changes the project; undoable and attributed">mutating</span>

Use a widget the way a player would: click a button (sends Wander `on ui "<name>"` and `on click` on the next tick while playing), toggle, set a slider/progress value, type into an input, scroll a scroll view, or click at a pixel (hit-tested like a mouse). While editing, value changes are recorded edits and clicks only report which events would fire. Example: {"element": "Play", "action": "click"} then sim_control step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `element` | integer \| string |  | Element to use |  |
| `at` | number[] |  | Pixel [x, y] to click instead of an element (hit test) |  |
| `width` | integer |  | Viewport width for `at` (default 1920) |  |
| `height` | integer |  | Viewport height for `at` (default 1080) |  |
| `action` | string |  | What to do (default click) | `click` `set_value` `type` `scroll` `focus` |
| `value` | number |  | set_value: new value; scroll: offset in pixels |  |
| `text` | string |  | type: text to put in an input (replaces unless append) |  |
| `append` | boolean |  | type: append instead of replace |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    ui_interact {"element": "Play", "action": "click"}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call ui_interact '{"element": "Play", "action": "click"}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "ui_interact",
        "arguments": {
          "element": "Play",
          "action": "click"
        }
      }
    }
    ```
